title: Confirmed ReadRange request with bounded nested range parameters
purpose: Exercise a real confirmed-service parser entry point with object/property/range context structure that is mutation-friendly and safer than the previous invalid abort-reason construct, while still probing nested tag decoding paths adjacent to documented BACnet parser-length issues.

messages.label: BACnet/IP BVLC original-unicast-npdu + NPDU + Confirmed-Request-PDU ReadRange

expected_behavior: Frame is accepted as a syntactically valid BACnet/IP confirmed request and dispatched through BVLC, NPDU, and APDU parsing to the ReadRange service decoder; implementation should either process or reject semantics cleanly without crash or out-of-bounds read.
constraints_preserved: BVLC header kept to four octets with total length 0x001b matching the full message size
Layering follows supplied structure: BVLC header, NPDU header, APDU payload
APDU first octet uses Confirmed-Request-PDU high nibble 0x00 from the supplied function-code table
Confirmed service choice 0x1a is ReadRange per supplied confirmed service catalog
NPDU included as a minimal common-header form using conservative model-prior completion only for undocumented octet values
Context-tag nesting is bounded and length-consistent; no oversized extended application length is used
Hex string has even length and represents one distinct non-duplicate seed
issue_safety_notes: This is a safe structural analogue only: it preserves nested tag-decoding pressure relevant to supplied parser issues but avoids malformed extended lengths, MAX_BVLC-sized padding, host-n-port crash bytes, and any exact historical payload collision.
